title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: LONNIE'S BIRDS
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight, Lonnie Price, a garbage truck driver in Charleston, South Carolina.
After forty years of four a.m. routes, he retired. Sheet cake.
The next morning, he woke up at four with nothing to do.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: THE PINK BIRD
segments.quote: Wonder is the feeling of a philosopher, and philosophy begins in wonder.
segments.author: Plato
lines: For a month, he watched game shows. So his wife Gloria handed him binoculars and pointed at the door.
At the marsh, he saw a pink bird with a spoon for a face. What in the world?
A retired nurse named Adele smiled and quoted Plato:
Wonder is the feeling of a philosopher, and philosophy begins in wonder.
That's a spoonbill, she said. Lonnie bought a bird book that day.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: THE LONG WAIT
segments.quote: Genius is nothing but a great aptitude for patience.
segments.author: Georges-Louis Buffon
lines: Next, he wanted to see a painted bunting, a bird colored like a paint store.
Three mornings, nothing. He stomped and checked his watch.
Adele read him a line from Buffon, a French scientist:
Genius is nothing but a great aptitude for patience.
So he sat on a stump for an hour without moving. The bunting landed three feet away.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: THE OWL
segments.quote: The most wasted of all days is that on which one has not laughed.
segments.author: Nicolas Chamfort
lines: Then he spotted a horned owl on the marina roof, and posted ninety-two pictures in the bird club chat.
Somebody replied, Lonnie, that's the plastic owl for the seagulls.
His face went hot. Then he remembered the French writer Chamfort:
The most wasted of all days is that on which one has not laughed.
So he laughed, and renamed himself Plastic Owl.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: OLD RAY
segments.quote: A true friend is the best possession.
segments.author: Benjamin Franklin
lines: His old truck partner Ray had retired too, and sat home yelling at the weather.
Lonnie almost didn't call. But Gloria kept a Ben Franklin calendar on the fridge:
A true friend is the best possession.
So Lonnie showed up at six with two coffees.
Ray grumbled for an hour. Then he saw a bald eagle and hollered like a winner.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: THE BROWN BIRD
segments.author: Aristotle
lines: Lonnie skipped the little brown birds. Boring.
Adele quoted Aristotle:
Nature does nothing in vain.
So he looked closer at one plain brown bird in the pines.
It was a rare sparrow, unseen in years. Lonnie made the paper. Ray's elbow too.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: THE BIG COUNT
segments.quote: Those who contemplate the beauty of the earth find reserves of strength that will endure as long as life lasts.
segments.author: Rachel Carson
lines: In December, Lonnie led a team at the Christmas bird count.
At sunrise, a thousand birds lifted off the marsh at once.
Adele quoted the scientist Rachel Carson:
Those who contemplate the beauty of the earth find reserves of strength that will endure as long as life lasts.
Lonnie still wakes at four. Now he has somewhere to be.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Wonder. Wait. Laugh. Call a friend. Look closer. Look up.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Wonder. Wait. Laugh. Call a friend. Look closer. Look up.
I tried bird watching once. A pigeon ate my sandwich.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night.
